_note: Extra comparison mappings: a parameter that the manual itself ties to ANOTHER common function (secondary link). Every entry must be backed by manual text quoted in 'note'. Applied idempotently at start-up; never changes manufacturer values.

links.note: Delta VFD-EL has no separate rated-motor-frequency parameter. The manual states for Pr.01.01 (Fbase): "This value should be set according to the rated frequency of the motor as indicated on the motor nameplate."

Delta VFD-EL has no separate rated-motor-voltage parameter. The manual states for Pr.01.02 (Vmax): "The Maximum Output Voltage setting must be smaller than or equal to the rated voltage of the motor as indicated on the motor nameplate." It limits the output voltage; it is not a nameplate entry.
Delta VFD-EL sets data bits, parity and stop bits together in the communication protocol choice of Pr.09.04 (e.g. Modbus RTU <8,N,2>, <8,E,1>), not in separate parameters.
